title: design-delta run state
description: Per-entity hashes from the most recent `design-delta snapshot` run (ADR-001 D6, roadmap #216). Written ONLY by `snapshot` — `audit`/`verify` read this file if present but never write it, preserving the audit path's read-only guarantee. `designHash` is optional: the design census's own per-component hash for the entity's design counterpart, written when a provider is configured and the contract's `sources.design` resolves (issue #481); an entity with no design counterpart omits it, never a null placeholder.

codeHash.description: Deterministic hash of the entity's current code-side census.

specHash.description: Deterministic hash of the entity's contract body, when it has one.

designHash.description: The design census's own hash (`design-components.json`'s `treeHash`) for the entity's design counterpart, read verbatim by `snapshot` when `sources.design` resolves (issue #481). Omitted, not null, when there is no design counterpart to hash.

lastSeen.description: When this entity was last observed in a snapshot run.
